name: Swamp Strider
lore: Création originale du jeu, selon le brief partiel ; pas une espèce canonique revendiquée.

assets.label: Swamp Strider — corps, deux orientations
assets.prompt: Create a NEW original alien riding animal design for the 2D Yautja fan-game La Longue Chasse, not a claimed canonical creature. Exactly TWO full-body SIDE profile drawings SIDE BY SIDE, left drawing facing RIGHT, right drawing facing LEFT. Same anatomy and scale in separately drawn opposing sides. Entire silhouette inside each half with generous MAGENTA #FF00FF blank margins, no cropping. Detailed painted game bitmap. No environment, ground shadow, labels, text, borders, rider, saddle, harness, armor, chains or effects. Bare creature base layer. Distinct limb roots and separated feet, physically plausible joints. Amphibious swamp-riding quadruped with EXACTLY FOUR long jointed stilt legs, long flexible rising neck and small narrow flat reptilian head, broad webbed four-toed feet that spread in mud, lean barrel body at height, slick mottled moss-green and dark teal hide with fine dorsal sensory frill. It is an alien amphibian, NOT a horse with a lizard head. Strong load-bearing shoulders, long tail for balance, four separate correctly joined leg silhouettes. Long neck sweeps gently forward, entire head feet tail visible. No reeds, puddles, breath or water FX.
notes: Identité en revue ; nombre de membres, appuis et détails à contrôler. Selle, cavalier et effets indépendants à produire.
